name: AI Usage
author: KyleLee
description: Multi-provider AI plan usage and balances in a native Omarchy Quattro panel.

barWidget.description: Usage windows, reset countdowns, balances, and provider switching for every provider configured in ai-usagebar-omarchy.

schema.label: Provider or account id
schema.description: Optional id from ai-usagebar-omarchy usage --json (for example openai or anthropic@work). Leave blank to switch between all configured entries.

schema.label: Show remaining
schema.description: Show what is left of each window in the bar tiles (kmi 62%) instead of the used percentage (kmi 38%). On by default.

schema.label: Tile all accounts
schema.description: Show every working account side by side, each led by its provider logo (on), or collapse the bar to the robot icon alone (off). On by default.
